async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Merge requests' link in the Project navigation section to go to the merge requests page
    await page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Project navigation").get_by_role("link", name="Merge requests").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # On the merge requests page, click the 'New merge request' link
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="New merge request").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Now on the new merge request page, fill in the form
    # Select source branch: 'build time debug'
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Source branch").click()
    await page.get_by_role("option", name="build time debug").click()
    
    # Select target branch: 'main'
    await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Target branch").click()
    await page.get_by_role("option", name="main").click()
    
    # Assign myself as reviewer (assuming my username is available in the reviewers dropdown)
    # This might require typing in a search box; using typical GitLab UI pattern
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Assign to").fill("my_username")  # Replace 'my_username' with actual username
    await page.get_by_role("option", name="my_username").click()  # Click the option that appears
    
    # Submit the merge request
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit merge request").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
